articles.classification: missing prerequisite added. The article did not say how the signature position is chosen. This is a new prerequisite, not a copy-only change.
articles.before: (No text. The article did not say where a Signer signs.)
articles.after: Mark each signature place in the paper before you upload the Document Version you will send. Type `/sig/` where each signature goes. You can make the text white so that it does not show. DocuSign puts a Sign Here field for each Signer at every `/sig/` it finds. In this version, all Signers share the same marks, so you cannot give one Signer a different place. If the paper has no `/sig/`, DocuSign puts no Sign Here field, and each Signer chooses where to sign.
